subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Sacred Marriage
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Sacred Marriage usable.

hook.text: Rama rescues Sita. Odysseus returns to Penelope. The hero's union is the story's emotional climax.

buildup.text: The sacred marriage represents opposites uniting: hero and beloved, action and wisdom, human and divine.

discovery.text: In alchemy, the sacred marriage is the union of sulfur and mercury—creating the philosopher's stone.

twist.text: The union isn't always romantic. It can mean integrating the hero's own divided nature—head and heart.

climax.text: The sacred marriage completes the hero. What was split becomes whole. The inner war finally ends.

punchline.text: Two halves. One whole. The real treasure.

quiz.question: What does the sacred marriage symbolize beyond romance?
options: Integration of the hero's divided self
